args.text:
The batch has 8 runs (r01–r08). All 8 were accepted, 0 were flagged and all 8 were cleared.
- Checks: rigid-body invariance and closure passed on every run, well inside their limits. Plane sections passed on r01–r05 and r07. It was not run on r06 and r08, which report the width-free ratio. Each of those two kept one remedy (the width-free ratio), had no roll-backs, and its kinematics match a run made without the remedy (r06 matches r02, r08 matches r05 and r07).
- Profiles: the centre strain-rate (REGR) peak is about 53 %/h at 421 µm from the tip in every run. Growth-zone length is 674–695 µm.
- Large |z| values: the growth-zone length and flank-difference |z| scores on r02, r05, r06, r07 and r08 are large only because the batch spread is so small. The actual gaps are about 21 µm out of 695 µm and about 1.2 %/h of flank difference against a 53 %/h peak, which are small.
- Flagged runs share nothing in common because none were flagged.
